scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @shanhaijing/api & npm run dev -w @shanhaijing/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shanhaijing/api && npm run build -w @shanhaijing/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @shanhaijing/api && npm run typecheck -w @shanhaijing/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @shanhaijing/api && npm run test -w @shanhaijing/web
scripts.build:static: npm run bake:static -w @shanhaijing/api -- --api "${BAKE_API_URL:-http://localhost:4000}" && VITE_DATA_MODE=static npm run build -w @shanhaijing/web -- --base=./
